hallmarks.name: Genomic instability
hallmarks.question: Can damage-response improvements preserve function without reducing tumor surveillance?

hallmarks.name: Telomere attrition
hallmarks.question: How do tissue-specific telomere dynamics differ from broad aging biomarkers?

hallmarks.name: Epigenetic alterations
hallmarks.question: Which age-associated epigenetic shifts are causal rather than passengers?

hallmarks.name: Loss of proteostasis
hallmarks.question: Which proteome maintenance changes predict functional recovery?

hallmarks.name: Disabled macroautophagy
hallmarks.question: When does altered recycling improve stress resistance rather than merely shift markers?

hallmarks.name: Deregulated nutrient sensing
hallmarks.question: Can interventions improve resilience without metabolic harm?

hallmarks.name: Mitochondrial dysfunction
hallmarks.question: Which mitochondrial changes drive decline in different tissues?

hallmarks.name: Cellular senescence
hallmarks.question: Which senescent-cell populations are harmful, protective, or context-dependent?

hallmarks.name: Stem cell exhaustion
hallmarks.question: Which tissue-specific regenerative losses are both reversible and safe to target?

hallmarks.name: Altered intercellular communication
hallmarks.question: Which network signals causally propagate age-related dysfunction?

hallmarks.name: Chronic inflammation
hallmarks.question: When is inflammation causal, compensatory, or necessary for repair?

hallmarks.name: Dysbiosis
hallmarks.question: How do microbiome shifts relate to host aging after controlling confounders?
